name: Remote Host CLI
description: Access the remote hosts linked to your aw-workspace account: installs an `aw-remote-hosts` CLI (status/exec/ps against the BYOD host linked via aw-remote-host) and contributes an MCP server so an agent can do the same, both scoped to only this account's own linked hosts.

skills.description: How to check status of, execute commands on, and manage processes on the remote hosts linked to this aw-workspace account, via the `aw-remote-hosts` CLI or this app's MCP server.
